territory-war.text: Territory War quest (only during territory wars, PvP)

clan.text: clan / clan leader quest (clan level-up, siege, mercenary)

dummy-script.text: tutorial / coupon placeholder script (the server runs it by itself)

steps-unknown.text: the quest script has no readable state machine (no transitions / no script): steps must be written by hand

saga-template.text: saga template quest (AbstractSagaQuest arrays): steps / items not resolved

memo-state.text: memo-state machine (no setCond): the engine cannot read the step

runtime-cond.text: setCond with a runtime value: the next step is decided by the script

unresolved-ids.text: NPC / monster ids from arrays the extractor could not resolve

drop-unresolved.text: a quest drop (item / chance) was not resolved

kill-parse.text: kill NPCs registered but no drop / kill step parsed

npc-no-spawn.text: an NPC of a step has no spawn in the datapack

npc-quest-spawned.text: an NPC of a step is spawned by the quest script (appears only during the quest)

npc-instance.text: an NPC of a step stands inside an instance / closed zone

mob-no-spawn.text: a monster of a step has no spawn and no known trigger

item-from-quest-mob.text: a quest item drops from a monster the quest script spawns (trigger known: the engine kills the trigger first)

spawn-script.text: a monster / NPC is spawned by a timer / event / other script hook the engine does not do

no-route.text: no route to a step place (atlas unreachable / no geodata walk)

route-pending.text: the geodata leg to a step place is not searched yet (run the tool again with walks)

route-blocked.text: a closed door on the way the party cannot open

route-conditional.text: the way needs something (airship window, items, Seven Signs, adena for a special teleport ...)

route-unverified.text: a walk on the way is a straight line not checked against the walls, or a gatekeeper link not seen on a live menu

route-swim.text: the way has a swim longer than one breath

aggro-on-way.text: aggressive monsters 6+ levels above the quest level touch the route

area-danger.text: the hunting place holds aggressive monsters 10+ levels above the quest level (or 3+ aggressive non-target spawns 8+ above)

dryrun-fail.text: the independent dry run (docs/plan/tools/quest_dryrun.js) does not pass: see the dryrun:<code> reasons

dryrun-no-script.text: no Java source for the dry run (pass --src <datapack root> once; Logs/quest_java_src.json remembers it)

no-hunt-place.text: no hunting place (field area / room / spawn cluster) for the monsters of a step

item-from-elsewhere.text: a step needs an item the quest does not give or drop (bought / crafted / another quest)

needs-party.text: a raid boss / party-only kill: needs the party (party mode) and a strong enough team

engine-manual.text: the swarm.js quest engine has no automatic action at a step (qeDecide = manual)

timer.text: the quest uses timers (despawns / waits) the engine does not watch
